title: Do the work without pricing it
summary: This meets the inner ledger still counting recognition and return. The line says selfless service dies when reward becomes part of the motive.
takeaway: Drop the bargain from the offering.
lifeApplication: When you feel yourself waiting to be thanked, blessed, or noticed, drop the bargain from the act. Finish the work before the ego invoices it.

source.shortMeaning: Reward-seeking empties service before the work is even done.
source.lifeApplication: When you start waiting for reward, finish the work before the ego invoices it.

evidence.coreClaim: Reward-seeking empties service before the work is even done.
evidence.turn: Service becomes true when the self stops asking to be seen.
evidence.practicalImplication: When you feel yourself waiting to be thanked, blessed, or noticed, drop the bargain from the act. Finish the work before the ego invoices it.
